items.title: Moderna, Merck Stock Jumps on Melanoma Vaccine News
items.summary: An experimental mRNA-based vaccine succeeded in preventing cancer from coming back or spreading in a study of high-risk melanoma patients, Moderna and its partner Merck said. Shares in Moderna jumped about 10% premarket, while Merck also climbed around 6%.
